## Play on Windows

1. Download **PhantomDescent-Windows.zip** below (under *Assets*).
2. Unzip it (right-click > *Extract All...*). Do not run the game from inside the ZIP.
3. Open the `PhantomDescent` folder and double-click **PhantomDescent.exe**.
   Java is included in the `jre` folder, so there is nothing else to install.
4. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info** then **Run anyway**
   (the game is not code-signed).

Choose **New Game** to play, or **Autoplay** on the title screen to watch an AI play the whole game
to the ending (press **F** to change its speed, **Esc** to stop). Autoplay never touches your save.

Controls: A / D move, Space jump, J strike, W interact, hold F to heal, K dash, L Light Bolt,
Tab map, Esc pause. Saves are kept in `C:\Users\<you>\.phantom-descent\`.
